question: Question
defaultDirections: Select the answer you feel answers the question. When you are done, press {checkAnswer}. You will get feedback indicating correctness of your answer and how to proceed.
relatedContentDescription: This creates a collapsed area for content related to this question and is always shown
hintDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer wrong
evidenceDescription: This is presented if the user gets the answer correct
noImage: Add an image in the settings.
dropzoneDirections: Select a label to pick it up, then select the region of the image it belongs on. Select a placed label to take it back. Some labels may be extra. When every region has a label, press {checkAnswer}.
keyboardDirections: With a keyboard: Enter or Space picks up a label, Tab moves between regions, Enter places the label and Escape puts it back.
placedOnSwap: {label} placed on {region}. {other} returned to the labels.
placeEvery: Place a label on every region ({placed} of {total}).
